raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector, rolled out from 2026-01-16, emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. The pipeline treats every timestamp as local, so v2 transactions are shifted 6 hours later (CST), which pushes evening sales into 00:00-06:00 and onto 2026-01-19. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago before deriving txn_ts and txn_date restores the correct local times and dates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN ((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) s WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
